ideas.pitch: An offline acoustic mesh network using walkie-talkies and audio modulation to transmit emergency alerts across dead zones on campus.
ideas.title: CampusPulse Acoustic Mesh
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven 'Unusual physical build' pattern from ICHack winners, standing out in a sea of standard web apps with real hardware integration.

ideas.pitch: An offline developer tool that runs code reviews locally utilizing on-device hardware acceleration to maintain complete code privacy.
ideas.title: NPU-Accelerated Local Code Reviewer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning strategy of targeting developer tooling and offline execution for privacy-first enterprise use cases.

ideas.pitch: A smart recycling bin prototype driven by a camera and a lightweight classifier model that physically sorts waste into compost, recycling, and landfill.
ideas.title: Edge-AI Autonomous Trash Sorter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines physical robotics with working live demos, which consistently impress judges looking for tangible builds.

ideas.pitch: A small-scale autonomous rover utilizing computer vision and ultrasonic sensors to navigate hallways and deliver small items between offices.
ideas.title: Autonomous Indoor Delivery Rover
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies the hardware-focused winning pattern from international robotics hacks, proving robust autonomous navigation within tight timeframe constraints.

ideas.pitch: A custom-designed hardware timer circuit using a 555 timer and logic counters to retrofit dumb campus appliances with smart auto-shutoff capabilities.
ideas.title: Custom PCB Smart Appliance Timer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Shows genuine hardware engineering and circuit design, echoing the surprise wins of physical electronics projects at hardware-focused events.
